pos: Physical obstruction that blocks or significantly narrows a public travelway (street, alley, sidewalk, bike lane), impeding passage.
Long-term placement of dumpsters, trailers, storage pods, or construction staging in the right-of-way reducing lane or sidewalk access.
Overgrown or overhanging vegetation intruding into street or sidewalk so people or vehicles cannot safely pass without leaving the facility.
Private items on tree lawn/tree plot obstructing curb cuts, driveways, hydrants, or sidewalk beyond brief loading/unloading.
neg: if detached tree limbs, logs, brush piles, or a fallen tree (yard waste) are the obstruction, classify as Excessive Growth instead
if vegetation maintenance is requested without describing blocked passage in the public right‑of‑way, classify as Excessive Growth instead
if complaint centers on dumpster overflow, scattered garbage, odor, or pickup/cleanup, classify as Trash instead
if residential trash or recycling carts are left blocking sidewalk or street, classify as Trash instead

pos: Overgrown vegetation on private property: tall grass/weeds/shrubs/hedges, including vacant lots and neglected yards
Private-property overgrowth encroaching onto sidewalks, driveways, or corner views from a specific yard, hedge, or fence
Accumulation of non-garbage junk/debris or scattered litter on private grounds, porches, alleys, or parking lots, absent curbside service context
Property-generated yard waste, limbs, or residents’ containers/debris creating a cleanup issue, even when spilling into adjacent sidewalk/right‑of‑way
neg: if household garbage, dumpster overflow, dumped bulky item (couch/mattress/appliance), or odor/rodents are mentioned, classify as Trash instead
if vegetation in the public right‑of‑way or city‑maintained area creates a traffic sightline hazard, classify as Line of Sight instead
if a freestanding object placed in the street/sidewalk (e.g., roll‑off dumpster/equipment) is the obstruction, classify as Blocked Street instead
if rocks/gravel/backfill or yard/drive damage after water utility digs, meter/line work, or restoration requests, classify as Water Utility Problems instead

pos: Vegetation in a public right-of-way obstructs a driver's view of oncoming traffic or traffic-control devices on a public street
Vegetation limits motorists’ ability to see cross-traffic at a public intersection, corner, or roundabout
Vegetation prevents drivers from seeing to exit a driveway or alley onto a named public street
Vegetation in a median, island, shoulder, or ditch creates a sight-distance hazard for roadway users
A traffic-safety or Risk Management report identifies a vegetation-related sight-distance hazard on a public roadway
neg: if vegetation originates from a specific private property’s yard, hedge, fence, or lot, classify as Excessive Growth instead
if the issue is vegetation encroaching on sidewalks/paths or forcing pedestrians into the street, classify as Excessive Growth instead
if a driveway/frontage/parking-lot visibility complaint omits the name of the public street being entered, classify as Excessive Growth instead
if an intersection report lacks explicit driver-action phrasing (e.g., pull out, turn, merge, approach) or public right-of-way location, classify as Excessive Growth instead

pos: Vehicle parked on grass, dirt, landscaped area, or other unpaved ground of a private yard or lot.
Any part of a vehicle rests on lawn, dirt, or unpaved ground, even if the remainder is in the street or driveway.
Vehicle parked on grassy/landscaped public greenspace—parks, medians, easements, or trail entrances—where no designated parking area exists.
Repeated or ongoing use of unpaved yard or ground for vehicle parking or storage, regardless of driveway availability.
Administrative requests explicitly about citations, notices, or hearings for parking on grass/unpaved surface violations.
neg: if obstruction is a non-vehicle object blocking a travel lane, alley, or sidewalk in the public right‑of‑way, classify as Blocked Street instead
if the issue is junk, debris, tires, or auto parts accumulation on the property rather than vehicles, classify as Trash instead
if vehicles are explicitly inoperable/abandoned or stored for months with no emphasis on unpaved surfaces, classify as Trash instead
if the request is a parking ticket billing/payment issue with no mention of grass/unpaved surfaces, classify as Parking Tickets/Payments instead

pos: Parks programming/amenities feedback and offers of materials/donations (e.g., summer concerts, supplies for facilities)
neg: vegetation overgrowth/blight on park-adjacent private property (Excessive Growth); signs at parks (Temporary Signage w/o

pos: Explicit recycling cue (recycling/recyclables/blue cart/bin) plus unsorted, mixed with trash/non-program items, or contamination noted.
Explicit recycling cue plus instruction or violation about preparation: please sort, no bags, rinse/empty, flatten or bundle cardboard.
Non-recyclable items placed in a recycling cart/bin or recyclables placed in plastic bags or outside required container.
Crew note or tag citing contaminated recycling (food, feces, cigarette butts) requiring education/compliance.
Items set out as recycling are not included in the recycling program.
neg: if collection failure is described (missed, not picked up, please pick up, no notice, others collected but not here), classify as Trash instead
if text references yard waste stream (yard waste, brush, leaves, grass, clippings), classify as Yard Waste instead
if contamination framed as garbage mixed with yard waste, classify as Yard Waste instead
if yard-waste-specific set-out is the issue (bundling limbs/brush, yard waste in plastic bags, sticker or weight limit), classify as Yard Waste instead

pos: Wastewater/sewer backup, overflow, clog, or slow drains implicating sanitary sewers, service laterals, mains, or manholes (indoors or discharging to street).
Sewer or rotten-egg/H2S odors, or symptoms attributed to sewer gas, indoors or outdoors.
Requests targeting sanitary-sewer assets: inspect/flush/jet/CCTV lines or manholes, or site restoration/yard repair explicitly tied to sewer main/lateral work.
Dye/smoke testing to verify sanitary-sewer connections, cross-connections, illicit connections, or service availability/status.
Failures, alarms, leaks, or overflows from lift/grinder stations, force mains, or private sewer ejector pumps, especially discharging wastewater to ground or street.
neg: if explicit potable-water asset (main/service line/meter/hydrant/valve) or drinking-water pressure/quality issue and no sewer-specific term/effect, classify as Water Utility Problems instead
if issue concerns storm drain, catch basin, storm sewer, culvert, or rain-driven street flooding, classify as Storm Drain Issues instead
if odor described as natural gas, propane, fuel, chemical, or carbon monoxide alarm, classify as Gas Utility Problems instead
if problem explicitly with private septic tank, leach field, or cesspool (onsite, not municipal), classify as Septic System Issues instead

pos: Physical sidewalk/curb condition and grade issues (e.g., sidewalk elevation lower than street, wraparound grade problems)
neg: sanitation service issues like missed trash pickup (Trash); sidewalk snow/ice and shoveling enforcement (Street Snow Rem

pos: Reports of clogged or blocked storm drains, inlets, catch basins, driveway culverts, ditches, or standpipes.
Storm sewer backing up, surcharging, or not conveying runoff during or after rain.
Standing or ponded water on streets or public right-of-way due to rainfall or blocked inlets.
Requests to install, adjust, or maintain public drainage components (inlets, culverts, standpipes, pipes, outfalls).
Drainage complaints or questions tied to grading, development, or parking-lot changes affecting runoff.
neg: if mentions water mains/service lines, meters, valves, hydrants, or shutoffs, classify as Water Utility Problems instead.
if yard-only standing water, no rain/storm/drain terms, and suspected leak, classify as Water Utility Problems instead.
if sanitary sewer backups, manholes overflowing, or sewage odors, classify as Sewer Problems instead.
if snow or ice on sidewalks or failure to shovel sidewalks, classify as Street Snow Removal instead.

pos: Snow and ice on public sidewalks and shoveling enforcement for adjacent properties/businesses (including public facilities), despite the “street” label
neg: storm drain/storm sewer clogs and leaf blockages (Sidewalk Snow Removal); sidewalk/curb defects (Sidewalk & Curb Complai

pos: Unpermitted or illegal business/temporary signs, including signs in the right-of-way, drive-through/pole promo signs, and similar temporary advertising
neg: objects/vehicles blocking ROW (Blocked Street); permanent structure safety (Unsafe Buildings); litter complaints (Trash)

pos: General traffic control/behavior issues (e.g., red-light running), alley direction/one-way configuration requests, and public street light outages
neg: vegetation-caused visibility problems (Line of Sight); ROW obstructions (Blocked Street); vehicles parked on lawns (Park

pos: Missed or partial curbside collection; return requested, no notice left, or neighbors collected but not here.
Set‑out/compliance violations: overweight (>40 lb), oversize can (>35 gal), missing pay‑per‑bag sticker, unacceptable container, or improper curb placement.
Hauler handling issues: bags ripped/dragged, spillage left, or carts/cans placed improperly by crew.
Refuse/debris cleanup: dumped household garbage, bulky household items, overflowing service carts/dumpsters, or waste causing odors/rodents/animal scattering.
Bulky household item at curb awaiting trash pickup for days/weeks.
neg: if explicit yard‑waste stream (yard waste/yardwaste/brush/leaves/branches) or yard‑waste program cues (seasonal rules, yard‑waste stickers/fees), classify as Yard Waste instead
if explicit recycling stream (recycling/recyclables/blue cart/bin) and issue is sorting/contamination/preparation or container delivery/size/placement, classify as Recycling instead
if accumulation on private grounds (yard/behind/beside/lot) with no curbside/hauler/dumpster/cart context, classify as Excessive Growth instead
if concern is obstruction of travel/right‑of‑way by objects with no cleanup/compliance intent, classify as Blocked Street instead

pos: Vacant or abandoned building has broken/missing doors/windows or other unsealed openings allowing public entry or weather intrusion.
Any structure shows visible structural failure or imminent collapse: leaning, partial collapse, foundation/roof holes, or separation from chimney or wall.
Detached garage, shed, or outbuilding reported unsafe or collapsing, or requiring boarding/sealing to prevent unauthorized entry.
Fire-damaged building reported unsecured or structurally unsafe after a fire incident.
Scaffolding or temporary shoring left long-term or visibly unstable, posing collapse or falling-debris risk to the public.
neg: if the dwelling is stated occupied and only minor defects are reported (e.g., broken window, rickety stairs), classify as Trash instead.
if the complaint references permits, inspection scheduling, or scope compliance without describing a physical hazard, classify as Trash instead.
if the issue is junk, debris, or hazardous materials on the porch/yard rather than a building defect, classify as Trash instead.
if the request concerns people living there or welfare checks without any building defect or unsecured opening, classify as Trash instead.

pos: Single-premises tap complaint of unusual taste, odor, discoloration, cloudiness, or sediment; customer requests investigation or guidance.
Single-premises hydraulic issues: low/no pressure, pressure surges, air/sputter, or pipe banging; request to check or test at the meter.
Single-premises leak concern with no visible water, damage, or flow; including near meter pit/curb/front yard; inspection only requested.
Appliance or interior-plumbing problem affecting water quality, temperature, or pressure at one premises; no request to repair utility assets.
Explicit account start/stop for a specific premises (activation/deactivation), including scheduled or after-hours appointments.
neg: if visible running/standing water, bubbling, sinkhole, or a confirmed break/leak in street/right‑of‑way, classify as Water Utility Problems instead
if asked to operate, repair, or replace city-owned hardware (meter, meter box/lid, curb stop, valve, hydrant), classify as Water Utility Problems instead
if turn-on/turn-off is requested without explicit account activation/deactivation, or to support a repair/curb‑stop operation, classify as Water Utility Problems instead
if request says 'possible water leak' or generic leak check without single-premises symptom/location, classify as Water Utility Problems instead

pos: Account/billing disputes and errors: misapplied addresses, incorrect bills, erroneous disconnect notices, and similar correspondence-driven billing issues
neg: operational sewer/water system failures (Sewer Problems/Water Utility Problems); water taste/color/pressure/noise (Water

pos: Visible or confirmed failures of potable-water assets (mains, services, hydrants, valves/curb stops, meters/pits/lids/boxes) causing leakage/flow, breakage, unsafe condition, or loss of control.
Continuous water surfacing or persistent yard/ground saturation without stormwater/drainage context, indicating a probable buried potable main/service leak on or near private property.
Suspected main/service leak or break needing field investigation, after-hours dispatches, or area-wide discoloration/grit persisting many hours beyond a single tap or appliance.
Operate/repair potable-water control points: curb stops/valves, or perform non-account water shutoff/turn-on for repairs, leak isolation, or contractor work.
Property restoration or cleanup (reseeding, backfill settlement, debris, driveway/sidewalk repair) explicitly due to water-utility excavation or meter/main/service work.
neg: if street ponding/flooding, or mentions storm/drainage assets (ditch/culvert/inlet/catch basin/standpipe) or erosion/drainage/grading/development, classify as Sidewalk Snow Removal instead.

if sewer assets/symptoms appear—manhole/cover, sewer main/lateral, lift/grinder/ejector pump, backups/clogs/slow drains/sewer odors, or restoration after sewer work—classify as Sewer Problems (Sanitary Sewers) instead.
if single-premises taste/odor/color/pressure/noise issues, appliance/water-heater problems, or 'leak' by meter pit/curb/front without visible flow/damage, classify as Water Quality instead.
if water turn-on/off is for moving, start/stop service, or account activation/deactivation, classify as Water Quality instead.

pos: Explicit yard‑waste/brush/leaves/branches term or 40‑lb limit, with set‑out compliance: required sticker/fee, 35‑gal can oversize/overfilled, or overweight.
Yard‑waste referenced container/prep violation: in plastic bags, improper container, not tied/bundled brush, packed too tight, or prohibited contents like dirt/rocks.
Yard‑waste program timing/season rules: not out by required time, wrong day, no winter collection, seasonal suspension, or placement violations.
Contamination involving yard waste: garbage mixed with yard waste or non‑program items included with brush/leaves.
Courtesy pickup documented for a yard‑waste violation/education, with explicit yard‑waste/brush/leaves reference.
neg: if sticker or 35‑gal/can size compliance is noted without any yard‑waste/brush/leaves/branches terms, classify as Trash instead
if complaint is a missed pickup/collection, even when yard‑waste is mentioned, classify as Trash instead
if recycling, recycle/blue cart/bin, or recyclables (bottles, cans, paper) are referenced, classify as Recycling instead
if tie/bundle requirement concerns cardboard or boxes without yard‑waste terms, classify as Recycling instead
